source_basis: With the development of technology and the explosive growth of data, it is more and more important to establish a suitable system.
interpretation: A trend is converted into a need for the system the paper builds.
applicability: Reusable as the first sentence of a summary.
counterevidence: The response named must be what the paper actually builds.

source_basis: In this paper, we build a model to analyze the factors, revealing how to make better use of data.
interpretation: The model is announced together with the two payoffs it delivers.
applicability: Reusable wherever a summary must name a model and its uses.
counterevidence: Both payoffs must appear later.

source_basis: In Task 1: First, we screen out the indicators. Then we use the combined weighting. Finally, we calculate a score.
interpretation: A whole task is compressed into three ordered beats ending on a number.
applicability: Reusable for reporting several tasks in a summary.
counterevidence: The order must match the body.

source_basis: We verify the validity of the model by comparing the difference between the simulation results and the evaluation model.
interpretation: Validity is defined as agreement between two methods.
applicability: Reusable when a paper checks one method against another.
counterevidence: The two methods must be independent, which here they are not.

source_basis: The errors are all smaller than 5%, showing the good applicability of the model.
interpretation: A uniform error bound is turned into a claim about scope.
applicability: Reusable after a sensitivity sweep.
counterevidence: The bound must be the computed one.

source_basis: Only by properly managing and making full use of information can cold data be transformed into visible wealth.
interpretation: The method is made a precondition of value by an inversion.
applicability: Reusable in a background section.
counterevidence: The value promised must be measurable.

source_basis: As a consequence, a reasonable assessment of its own capabilities has become the key.
interpretation: The background lands on the paper's task.
applicability: Reusable as the closing line of a background.
counterevidence: The task must follow.

source_basis: Considering the background information and restricted conditions, we need to solve the following problems.
interpretation: The restatement is signalled as faithful before the bullets.
applicability: Reusable at the head of a problem restatement.
counterevidence: The bullets must match the statement.

source_basis: It became the prototype of the maturity model.
interpretation: The model is traced back to its earliest source.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a literature review.
counterevidence: The lineage must be accurate.

source_basis: They formulated a four-level model, but the advantages are lacking in elaboration.
interpretation: A prior study is credited and then marked for what it leaves out.
applicability: Reusable inside a literature review.
counterevidence: The gap must be one the paper fills.

source_basis: Through the analysis of many literatures, it can be seen that there is still a lack of research on digital maturity models.
interpretation: A review closes by naming the opening the paper fills.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a literature review.
counterevidence: The lack must match the contribution.

source_basis: Our work in this problem is mainly shown in the figure.
interpretation: The whole plan is delegated to one diagram.
applicability: Reusable where the overview is visual.
counterevidence: The figure must show the plan.

source_basis: These constructions are the background and basis for our subsequent analysis.
interpretation: The assumptions are raised from a list to a foundation.
applicability: Reusable as the opening of an assumption section.
counterevidence: The analysis must use them.

source_basis: In order to make the indicator analysis clear and controllable, we assume that other indicators found later are not considered.
interpretation: An omission is licensed by the tractability it buys.
applicability: Reusable when an assumption excludes something.
counterevidence: The exclusion must be stated plainly.

source_basis: This is done to analyze how to use the data assets to their fullest potential.
interpretation: One assumption is tied to one later section in a single line.
applicability: Reusable as a justification line.
counterevidence: The later section must exist.

source_basis: The key mathematical notations used in this paper are listed in Table 1.
interpretation: The symbols are handed to a table in one sentence.
applicability: Reusable as the only sentence of a notation section.
counterevidence: The table must follow.

source_basis: The systematic index system is definitely not the bigger the better.
interpretation: A naive rule is rejected before the indicators are chosen.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an indicator section.
counterevidence: A selection principle must follow.

source_basis: We summarize the experience from the original data, and then rise to the system level.
interpretation: Grounded theory is described as a climb from data to system.
applicability: Reusable when indicators are built bottom up.
counterevidence: The data must be real.

source_basis: We extract available indicators and follow the principles of generalization, completeness and little overlap.
interpretation: Three tests are named before the list.
applicability: Reusable ahead of any indicator list.
counterevidence: The tests must be applied.

source_basis: Which comprehensively reflects the maturity level and provides strategic guidance.
interpretation: The model is said to measure and to guide at once.
applicability: Reusable when a model inherits from an earlier one.
counterevidence: Both jobs must be done.

source_basis: The model we constructed comprehensively answered the confusion of the recruitment managers.
interpretation: A figure is tied to a named stakeholder's question.
applicability: Reusable after an indicator diagram.
counterevidence: The stakeholder must have raised the question.

source_basis: The specific analysis process will not be repeated here.
interpretation: A parallel argument is declined.
applicability: Reusable for a repeated case.
counterevidence: The cases must truly be parallel.

source_basis: Therefore, a more comprehensive and scientific maturity evaluation model is constructed.
interpretation: The survey is closed with the model it produced.
applicability: Reusable at the end of an indicator section.
counterevidence: The comparison must be earned.

source_basis: Comparing the figures, the firm is lacking in all three levels, so the maturity is not ideal.
interpretation: A judgement is read off a set of figures.
applicability: Reusable after comparative diagrams.
counterevidence: The figures must support the deficit.

source_basis: The determination of the weights plays a crucial role, which directly affects the accuracy of the evaluation.
interpretation: The weighting section is justified before any formula.
applicability: Reusable at the head of a weighting section.
counterevidence: The consequence must be real.

source_basis: This is a comprehensive evaluation method that combines subjective and objective, which can effectively improve the rationality and correctness.
interpretation: A hybrid is defended by what it joins.
applicability: Reusable when two weighting methods are merged.
counterevidence: Both kinds must be used.

source_basis: According to the concept of self-information and entropy, the information entropy can be calculated, and thus.
interpretation: A formula is derived from a named concept.
applicability: Reusable before an entropy formula.
counterevidence: The formula must implement the concept.

source_basis: In order to ensure the accuracy of the judgment matrix, we perform a consistency check.
interpretation: A check is motivated before it is presented.
applicability: Reusable ahead of a validation step.
counterevidence: The check must be carried out.

source_basis: If the calculated CR is less than 0.1, then the judgment matrix can pass the consistency test.
interpretation: A test is given its decision rule.
applicability: Reusable for any pass-fail statistic.
counterevidence: The threshold must be the conventional one.

source_basis: The difference between the two weights should be the same as the difference between the coefficients. As a result.
interpretation: An analogy is turned into an equation.
applicability: Reusable when a mixing rule needs a motive.
counterevidence: The equation must express the analogy.

source_basis: Based on the idea of the Topsis method, we process the score and introduce a membership function.
interpretation: Only one idea is borrowed from a named method.
applicability: Reusable for a partial borrowing.
counterevidence: Do not upgrade it into the whole method.

source_basis: The system is in a relatively mature range, and there is still room for improvement to a certain extent.
interpretation: A good score is kept from sounding final.
applicability: Reusable after a result that is not the best band.
counterevidence: The next section must use the room.

source_basis: Consider adopting the goal planning model, to convert the goal to maximize the score.
interpretation: A vague goal is recast as a maximization.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an optimization.
counterevidence: The quantity maximized must belong to the model.

source_basis: Step 1: Determination of decision variables. This paper assumes the cost of a 1% increase is known.
interpretation: The optimization is made auditable as numbered steps.
applicability: Reusable for any stated program.
counterevidence: The steps must be sequential.

source_basis: The existing indicators can only be maintained or improved, in consequence.
interpretation: A constraint is verbalized before its formula.
applicability: Reusable ahead of a sign constraint.
counterevidence: The formula must match the words.

source_basis: It can not only conduct comprehensive macro research but also conduct micro analysis from a single factor.
interpretation: A method is sold on working at two scales.
applicability: Reusable for a system-dynamics section.
counterevidence: Both scales must be shown.

source_basis: The value is 7.6%, lower than 10%, which is high precision, verifying the validity and stability.
interpretation: A number is cashed against a stated cutoff.
applicability: Reusable after an error computation.
counterevidence: The comparison must not be the model against itself.

source_basis: If the limited capital is invested in these two aspects, the greatest potential of data assets can be exerted.
interpretation: The largest gap is converted into spending advice.
applicability: Reusable after a comparison of levels.
counterevidence: The factor must be the largest gap.

source_basis: Formulate the standard to measure the effectiveness, which is mainly solved by the association algorithm.
interpretation: A task is assigned to one named algorithm.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of an algorithm section.
counterevidence: The algorithm must be the one used.

source_basis: The support and confidence are measured by setting thresholds. The minimum support is 20% and the minimum confidence is 60%.
interpretation: The two cutoffs that drive the mining are stated outright.
applicability: Reusable before any mined rule.
counterevidence: The rules reported must meet the cutoffs.

source_basis: The rules indicate that the fourth-level people level has extremely high support for the fifth-level maturity.
interpretation: One rule is read as evidence for a required level.
applicability: Reusable per rule group.
counterevidence: The statistics must be the mined ones.

source_basis: Comprehensive analysis of all rules: when people and process reach the fourth level and technology the third or fourth, the effectiveness is fine.
interpretation: Every rule collapses into one operating standard.
applicability: Reusable at the end of a rule list.
counterevidence: Every condition must be backed by a rule.

source_basis: Analyzing whether the model can be used for larger or smaller companies, which is essentially a test of the model.
interpretation: An application question is renamed as a test.
applicability: Reusable at the opening of a sensitivity section.
counterevidence: The test must be performed.

source_basis: Larger companies lean on stability; smaller ones lean on personal ability. Therefore companies of different scales have different emphases.
interpretation: A contrast motivates the reweighting.
applicability: Reusable before changing weights by size.
counterevidence: Both cases must be stated.

source_basis: The error is small, and both remain below 5%, which shows the good applicability.
interpretation: A flat error curve is read as evidence of scope.
applicability: Reusable after a sensitivity plot.
counterevidence: The claim must stay inside the sizes tested.

source_basis: The universality of the system lies in.
interpretation: A generality claim is opened with its reasons to follow.
applicability: Reusable at the head of a transfer argument.
counterevidence: The reasons must come next.

source_basis: The model is not directly based on the data of the specific company, but evaluates from the perspectives of people, technology and process, thus ensuring it can be transferred.
interpretation: Transfer is defended by what the model avoids.
applicability: Reusable in a generality argument.
counterevidence: The angles must be shared by the target domain.

source_basis: If their customers also use the model, there will be the following benefits.
interpretation: A benefits list is opened conditionally.
applicability: Reusable before a list of gains.
counterevidence: The benefits must be specific.

source_basis: The combination of the two methods enhances the robustness of the model.
interpretation: Robustness is credited to the pairing rather than to either method.
applicability: Reusable in a strengths section.
counterevidence: Both methods must be present.

source_basis: Making our models both theoretical and innovative.
interpretation: The models are claimed to inherit theory and add to it.
applicability: Reusable as a closing strength.
counterevidence: Both qualities must be defensible.

source_basis: We could have analyzed the relationship in more depth, but due to space limitations, our work can only do this for the time being.
interpretation: A deeper analysis is conceded and blamed on the page limit.
applicability: Reusable in a limitations section.
counterevidence: The missed analysis must be real.

source_basis: Due to the lack of actual numerical reference, we can only observe the accuracy from the comparison, but cannot measure it through actual company data.
interpretation: The evidence states what it allows and what it rules out.
applicability: Reusable as an honest bound on validation.
counterevidence: The unavailable check must not be implied.

source_basis: We are the researchers invited by the company to assess the maturity of its system.
interpretation: The letter opens by naming who asked and for what.
applicability: Reusable as the first line of a letter.
counterevidence: The invitation must be real.

source_basis: Only with a sufficiently mature system can these data be fully utilized and save your precious time.
interpretation: The system is connected to the reader's own interest.
applicability: Reusable in the body of a letter.
counterevidence: The benefit must be plausible.

source_basis: The system got a score of 0.8173, which proves that it is relatively mature. It also confirms the strength, only slightly lacking in talent management and teamwork.
interpretation: The result is delivered as proof and softened by one named gap.
applicability: Reusable for reporting a score to a lay reader.
counterevidence: The gap must be the one found.

source_basis: I believe that using our evaluation system, you can have a deeper understanding. You will also have more trust, to achieve mutual benefit and win-win.
interpretation: The letter closes by transferring the benefit to the reader.
applicability: Reusable as a letter's last move.
counterevidence: The basis must support the range claimed.

source_basis: Seventeen indicators: six for people, six for technology, five for process, each capped at one.
interpretation: The system is reduced to a fixed indicator set before any weighting.
applicability: The pattern transfers to any maturity assessment.
counterevidence: The set is drawn from literature, not from the firm's data.

source_basis: The entropy weight and the hierarchy weight are blended with shares fixed by equating two distances.
interpretation: The mix is determined by a rule rather than chosen.
applicability: Reusable for any two-method weighting.
counterevidence: The shares are never computed.

source_basis: The weighted sum is rescaled between a theoretical minimum and maximum and read on five bands.
interpretation: A raw score becomes a placement.
applicability: Reusable for any composite index.
counterevidence: The two extremes are never valued.

source_basis: Fractional improvements maximize the score subject to a unit cap, a budget and nonnegativity.
interpretation: The upgrade is a bounded linear program.
applicability: Reusable wherever a maturity score is to be raised under a budget.
counterevidence: The program is never solved.

source_basis: Five maturity levels are simulated and compared with the evaluation by percentage error.
interpretation: A dynamic simulation is used as a second opinion.
applicability: Reusable as a cross-check.
counterevidence: The simulation has no equations.

source_basis: Scores are discretized into bands and mined for association rules.
interpretation: A continuous score is turned into an operating protocol.
applicability: Reusable after any maturity scoring.
counterevidence: Only twelve simulated rows underlie the mining.

source_basis: Reject the bigger-the-better rule, name three principles, then list the indicators.
interpretation: The selection is argued before it is shown.
applicability: Reusable for any indicator construction.
counterevidence: The principles are not shown being applied.

source_basis: Measure, identify priorities, implement: the upgrade is staged in three steps.
interpretation: The advice follows a fixed order.
applicability: Reusable for an improvement section.
counterevidence: The priorities come from a chart, not from the program.

source_basis: People rules, technology rules, process rules, then one combined standard.
interpretation: The conclusion is withheld until every group is read.
applicability: Reusable for rule mining.
counterevidence: The combined standard cites levels the discretization does not use.

source_basis: The model transfers because it avoids firm-specific data and rests on grounded theory and a standard.
interpretation: Generality is argued from abstraction rather than from testing.
applicability: Reusable for a transfer claim.
counterevidence: The size test covers only seaports.

source_basis: Figure 6 draws the weights as horizontal bars.
interpretation: The weighting result is meant to be readable at a glance.
applicability: A bar chart suits a weight vector.
counterevidence: The printed values repeat inside groups and cannot sum to one.

source_basis: Figure 7 is a color bar from zero to one with five named bands and the marker in Good.
interpretation: The score, the band and the distance to the top are visible together.
applicability: Reusable for any graded index.
counterevidence: The band edges disagree with the rule-analysis prose.

source_basis: Figure 10 plots the good level against the excellent level on a radar chart.
interpretation: The gap that drives the spending advice is shown rather than told.
applicability: Reusable for a two-state comparison.
counterevidence: The eight axes group several indicators, so the gap is not per indicator.

source_basis: Figure 14 plots the error against seaport size.
interpretation: Applicability is argued from a curve rather than from a table.
applicability: Reusable for a sensitivity result.
counterevidence: The curve was not inspected on the raster; the claim rests on the prose.

source_basis: The judgement matrix passes when its consistency ratio falls below 0.1.
interpretation: A conventional gate is adopted for the subjective weights.
applicability: Reusable for any hierarchy weighting.
counterevidence: No ratio is computed.

source_basis: The good level returns 7.6 percent, below the ten percent line.
interpretation: The simulation is accepted by a cutoff.
applicability: Reusable as a stated acceptance rule.
counterevidence: The reference series comes from the same model.

source_basis: Every error stays under five percent as the relative size changes.
interpretation: Stability across scale is the evidence offered for transfer.
applicability: Reusable for a size sensitivity.
counterevidence: The errors are simulated, not measured.

source_basis: Scores are normalized by their column sum before the entropy.
interpretation: The entropy needs a distribution, so the columns are turned into one.
applicability: Reusable ahead of an entropy weight.
counterevidence: No data table is shown.

source_basis: The mining uses simulated scores split into experimental and control sets.
interpretation: The protocol is built without any firm data.
applicability: Marks the boundary of the evidence.
counterevidence: Twelve rows is a thin base for association rules.

source_basis: Four assumptions, each followed by a justification.
interpretation: No assumption is left bare.
applicability: Reusable as a section pattern.
counterevidence: Two justifications only restate the assumption.

source_basis: The cost of a one-percent rise is assumed known because the analysis needs it.
interpretation: A parameter is assumed into existence to make the program writable.
applicability: Reusable as a warning pattern.
counterevidence: The assumption is what keeps the program from being solved.

source_basis: The maturity is 0.8173, in the Good band, short of 0.9.
interpretation: The headline number is placed on the scale in the same breath.
applicability: Reusable for reporting an index.
counterevidence: The number cannot be reproduced from the given formulas.

source_basis: The widest gap is teamwork and technical management, so the limited capital goes there.
interpretation: The recommendation names the factor and the action.
applicability: Reusable for spending advice.
counterevidence: The linear program, which should decide this, is unsolved.

source_basis: The operating standard is people at level four, technology at level three or four, process at level four.
interpretation: The mining ends in a protocol rather than in a list of rules.
applicability: Reusable after association-rule mining.
counterevidence: The quoted confidence does not match the table.

source_basis: Equation (3) sums f_ij times a logarithm, and f_ij is never defined.
interpretation: The entropy cannot be recomputed.
applicability: A defect to record, not to repair.
counterevidence: The prose calls the result the information entropy regardless.

source_basis: Figure 6 repeats weights inside groups, so the bars cannot be the combined weights.
interpretation: The figure and the formula disagree.
applicability: A defect to record.
counterevidence: The figure may show group weights, but nothing says so.

source_basis: Equation (14) weights cost by the score, equation (16) adds the index symbols, and the symbol b is reused from the judgement matrix.
interpretation: The program as printed is not the program described.
applicability: A defect to record.
counterevidence: The program is unsolved, so the damage stays latent.

source_basis: Equation (17) sums over i while the terms are indexed by t.
interpretation: The error formula is ambiguous as printed.
applicability: A defect to record.
counterevidence: The reported 7.6 percent is unaffected only if the eight pairs exist.

source_basis: Table 4 keeps rules at 19.05 percent support and 57.14 percent confidence, below the stated 20 and 60 percent cutoffs, and the prose quotes 85.71 where the table prints 85.17.
interpretation: The protocol rests on rules the paper's own thresholds exclude.
applicability: A defect to record.
counterevidence: The paper presents the table as the effective rules.

source_basis: The letter is printed after the reference list, and section 7.2 points to figure 5 for the benefits while figure 5 is the index hierarchy.
interpretation: Two structural slips: the letter position and a wrong cross-reference.
applicability: Worth keeping as a layout warning.
counterevidence: Neither changes the argument.
